components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single recommendation action that starts one location request and one nearby search.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; min-width: min(100%, 280px); min-height: 58px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--green); border-radius: var(--radius-control); color: var(--surface); background: var(--green); text-align: left; font: inherit; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--green-dark); background: var(--green-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:active { border-color: var(--green-dark); background: var(--green-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { border-color: var(--muted); background: var(--muted); cursor: wait; } .ds-btn-detail { margin-top: 5px; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

components.name: Radius Range
components.description: A keyboard- and touch-friendly range control for the user's walkable radius.
components.html: <label class="ds-range-label" for="ds-radius">搜尋距離</label><output class="ds-range-value" for="ds-radius">100 公尺</output><input class="ds-range" id="ds-radius" type="range" min="100" max="3000" step="100" value="100" aria-label="搜尋距離">
components.css: .ds-range-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 750; } .ds-range-value { display: block; margin: 8px 0 12px; color: var(--green); font: inherit; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 850; } .ds-range { display: block; width: 100%; height: 28px; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; accent-color: var(--green); cursor: pointer; appearance: none; } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--line); } .ds-range::-moz-range-track { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--line); } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-top: -8px; border: 3px solid var(--green); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface); appearance: none; } .ds-range::-moz-range-thumb { width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 3px solid var(--green); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface); } .ds-range:hover::-webkit-slider-thumb, .ds-range:active::-webkit-slider-thumb { background: var(--green); } .ds-range:hover::-moz-range-thumb, .ds-range:active::-moz-range-thumb { background: var(--green); } .ds-range:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
EatThis is a calm, precise city utility that should feel useful in a real hand, not staged for a campaign. The visual language is a cool sheet of city paper: deep ink carries the reading load, thin rules organize the route, and one jade action color marks the next decision.

The experience moves in one vertical read from distance to decision to destination. Information stays close to its action, live place data is allowed to wrap, and the destination sheet is quiet enough that the external map action remains obvious. The system uses a Traditional Chinese-first system sans stack, restrained geometry, and flat tonal surfaces to keep a daily food choice quick and credible.
keyCharacteristics: Calm city utility with transit-grade information discipline.
One deliberate jade accent for action and selected state.
Cool paper, white surface, deep ink, and fine rules instead of decorative chrome.
One readable path from radius choice to a single destination.
Traditional Chinese-first typography with safe wrapping for live place data.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Jade is the only chromatic action color; reserve it for an action, a selected state, or the current value that needs attention.

rules.name: The Clear Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use weight, scale, and whitespace to show what happens next; do not make every line compete with the opening decision.

rules.name: The One Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep the recommendation journey in one vertical read: choose a walkable radius, make one request, announce the state, and show one destination.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat at rest; use tonal contrast, rules, and state color to establish hierarchy before adding any visual effect.

dos: Do use the cool-paper, white-surface, deep-ink, muted-ink, rule-grey, and jade roles for their stated functions.
Do keep one primary action visually dominant and pair it with a short secondary detail line.
Do preserve fine rules and whitespace as the main structural devices.
Do let user-provided or provider-returned names and addresses wrap naturally.
Do keep interactive controls keyboard reachable with a visible high-contrast focus treatment.
Do preserve official attribution assets at their supplied aspect ratio and with an accessible name.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, heavy shadows, warm multi-accent palettes, or ornamental background effects.
Don't turn every section into a separate card, badge, pill, or decorative chrome element.
Don't truncate live place names, addresses, or navigation intent to protect a fixed visual shape.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate status, errors, or recovery.
Don't expose raw provider identifiers as user-facing labels.
